messages:
Samira Patel: Quick thread for Rachel Gomez (product manager) onsite 2026-11-04. Arrival 08:50, interviews 10:00-15:30. Requests: pescatarian lunch, short private room for a 20m phone call, EV parking/charger access for their rental, and a simple USB-C adapter. Also asked if we can have the offer packet printed for same-day sign (paper preferred). Can we confirm?
Liam Chen: I'll handle interview rooms. Suggest Quiet Room F for the private call (it's windowed + quieter). Want me to reserve a hot desk near the interview rooms for Rachel to set up?
Samira Patel: Yes please reserve a hot desk by Conf Hall 2 for 09:00-16:30. Also add a 10m buffer after each session.
Nora Kim: I've reconfirmed Rachel's name as on ID. I'll send the offer PDF and note that she prefers paper. Nora: Should we bring a printed offer + pen to front desk or hand to hiring manager?
Liam Chen: Please leave printed packet at Front Desk in envelope labeled "Rachel Gomez - Offer" and I'll sign/hand it during lunch if available.
Facilities: EV parking note: We have one guest EV charger in Lot B. I'll reserve Spot B-EV01 for 11/04 07:30-18:00 and tape a temporary permit on the post. We'll add an extension cable if needed.
Front Desk: Acknowledged. We'll hold envelope and badge; require photo ID at pickup. We'll also store the USB-C adapter in the envelope.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: badge, hot desk, EV spot, printed offer, adapter, catering. Calendar invites updated. :white_check_mark:
Samira Patel: Catering: pescatarian with dairy-free option. Order 2 boxed lunches for panel + candidate for 12:30. Any allergies?
Nora Kim: Candidate notes say mild shellfish allergy; ensure kitchen marks items clearly. I'll put that in the candidate doc.
Liam Chen: Loaner adapter: asset H-24 available. I'll tag it and leave it in envelope. Locker not needed.
Facilities: EV permit will be taped and we will SMS the gate code to Front Desk morning of.
Samira Patel: One more: Rachel asked whether we can reimburse a rideshare up to $70 if their flight is delayed and they miss the shuttle. Policy OK?
Nora Kim: Per policy — we cover reasonable expedited travel with receipts and manager approval. I'll include reimbursement link in the confirmation email.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar update posted: ICS link https://calendar.company/ical/2109876543. Flight monitor enabled for RG-220 (if traveling). Will post arrival updates.
Liam Chen: Who will meet Rachel at lobby? I can if I'm free; otherwise Nora can.
Nora Kim: I can be at the lobby at 08:45 and hand off the packet. If I'm in an interview, Liam pls step in.
Front Desk: We'll release badge to Nora or Liam after ID check. Envelope will be in the drawer labeled "Recruiting Packets".
Samira Patel: Thanks team. I'll upload the final candidate note with EV spot + shellfish allergy + offer packet location. Ping here if anything changes. :pray:
